name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset
description: The AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance dataset reflects real predictive maintenance data encountered in industry. It consists of 10,000 data points with 14 features capturing milling machine operational parameters (air temperature, process temperature, rotational speed, torque, tool wear) and labels for five independent failure modes: tool wear failure, heat dissipation failure, power failure, overstrain failure, and random failure.
